meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,它会把“找代码位置”“一两个文件内的小改动”“审查改动”分别交给 investigator、builder、reviewer 三个子代理。它们返回压缩后的精简结果(通常带文件路径和行号),比普通做法更省主对话空间。
howto.when: 当你要定位某段代码(查定义/调用/用法)、改动不超过两个文件、或审查 diff/分支/文件里的 bug,并且想要精简输出而非长篇叙述时,会派给对应子代理。

say.text: 帮我查一下 calculate_price 在哪定义,谁在调用它?
say.note: 会派找代码的子代理,回报路径和行号。

say.text: 把 src/utils.ts 第 88 行的错误提示改准确,只动这一个文件。
say.note: 会派改代码的子代理,完成后回报验证结果。

say.text: 帮我看下当前分支的改动,指出可疑的 bug。
say.note: 会派审查子代理,按行号列出问题与修复建议。

howto.what_en: With this enabled Claude gives locate-code, 1-2-file edits, and diff reviews to compressed-output subagents (investigator/builder/reviewer) instead of working inline or using Explore. Their terse path/line reports save main-context space.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude would locate code (definition/callers/uses), make a surgical 1-2-file edit, or review a diff/branch/file for bugs, and compressed output is preferred over prose.

say_en.text: Where is calculate_price defined, and who calls it?
Fix the error message at line 88 of src/utils.ts; only touch that file.
say_en.note: Directs to builder; verifies the change after edit.

say_en.text: Review my current branch's diff and list likely bugs.
say_en.note: Sends reviewer; reports findings sorted by line.
